$description: Hand-authored shell layout dimensions — topbar, sidebar, statusbar, right context panel. Values are already in rem so they convert 1:1 to DTCG dimension objects.

topbar-height.$description: Main topbar row height. 66 px at base=16.

sidebar-collapsed.$description: Sidebar width when collapsed to icons only. 60 px.

sidebar-expanded.$description: Sidebar width when expanded with labels. 240 px.

context-width.$description: Right context panel width when open. 400 px.
